title: pleopeltis irioides
intro: Pleopeltis irioides, commonly known as the 'Resurrection Fern', is a type of epiphytic fern species native to the Americas. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to protect against cancer cell growth. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis irioides include its antimicrobial, antiproliferative, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
